observations.summary: Avoid chemical drain openers and use a drain snake; chemicals can kill tank bacteria; keep grease, wipes and paper towels out of drains and toilets; garbage disposals push solids into the drainfield and can clog its pipes. Fetched directly on 2026-10-25 for earlier merged posts and reused.
observations.inference_limit: National septic guidance; applied to sewer homes only as general good practice.
